why_null: All four cases in the library were considered and none matched at the motif level, so this narrative carries no Echo panel. The shape here has two moving parts: a recording of an event that was already reported and dated is carried without its date so that a settled record reads as an emergency in progress, and then the absence of matching coverage is converted into intent to silence, a step that no observation can bear on because coverage found is read as late and coverage missing is read as proof. The call to amplify follows from that closed loop rather than from any figure or provision. B-01 (casualty-inflation cascade, May 2019) runs on a single invented count that outran every correction; this spine carries no count at all, and its opening node asserts a time rather than a magnitude. B-02 (fabricated-provision cascade, Oct 2020) attributes clauses to a legal text whose final wording was not yet public; here there is no instrument, no clause and no scope, and the underlying footage was reported accurately at its own date by the same outlets that now record the wave. B-03 (moral-shock acceleration, Aug 2025) is the tempting one and is rejected on structure: it documents a contemporaneous recording of a fresh incident compressing nationwide mobilization into hours, where record and event belonged to the same moment. This narrative moves the date of a record whose event has passed, and its load-bearing step is the suppression inversion, which B-03 documents nowhere. That some clips in this wave are dated back to the Makassar footage of B-03 makes the pairing topical adjacency, which is exactly the resemblance the threshold refuses. B-04 (scope-inflation panic, Jan 2025) shares only the urgency tail. Its motif needs a rule drawn narrow in a written instrument and retold as reaching wider, and its urgency came from a dated changeover in that instrument; here nothing was narrowed in text, the inflation runs along time rather than scope, and the urgency is manufactured by the suppression step itself. No documented episode in this library has the shape of an unfalsifiable absence step or of a re-dated record, so the Echo section stays silent, which blueprint D-15 permits explicitly.
